title: POV: pied kingfisher, no perch needed
caption:
Perches are optional when you can hover.

Pied kingfishers form communal roosts at certain times of year, and you can find them over lakes and rivers across India and Africa. This one was filmed at Queen Elizabeth National Park, Uganda.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Ceryle rudis).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
